title: Learning Course Protocol (LCP)
description: JSON Schema for LearnByDiff course.yml and chapter YAML documents. Wire via YAML language server ($schema comment or yaml.schemas). Protocol evolves additively; all course.yml fields are optional.

sourceDirPath.description: Directory path relative to the source repository root (or source.root). Nested paths allowed; no absolute paths or '..' segments.

relativeFilePath.description: File path relative to the chapter snapshot tree root (inside fromDir / toDir).

repository.description: Git URL or filesystem path to the source repository. Defaults to `.` (the directory that contains `.course-config`). Relative paths resolve from the course repository.

root.description: Optional subdirectory under repository that prefixes every chapter fromDir / toDir.

course.description: All fields optional. Defaults: id from parent of `.course-config` (or `{repo}-learn` at a git root), title=id, source.repository=`.`.

id.description: Stable course id (also used as the default learning workspace folder name). Defaults from the `.course-config` parent directory.

title.description: Human-readable course title. Defaults to id.

chapter.description: All fields optional. Defaults: id from filename (strip numeric prefix), title=id, empty fromDir/toDir = empty trees, omitted entryFiles = all files under toDir.

id.description: Stable chapter id (unique within the course). Defaults from the yaml filename.

title.description: Human-readable chapter title. Defaults to id.

fromDir.description: Start snapshot directory under the source repo (or source.root). Empty = empty start tree.

toDir.description: Goal snapshot directory under the source repo (or source.root). Empty = empty goal tree.

entryFiles.description: Optional paths relative to the chapter snapshot tree root. When omitted, all files under toDir are used.

docs.description: Optional chapter documentation: an http(s) URL, or a file path relative to the chapter snapshot tree (toDir / fromDir), e.g. README.md or notes/guide.pdf.
